name: 19440 · Hatfield, PA
findings: ZIP 19440 (Hatfield) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19440 (Hatfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19440 (Hatfield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
